remarks: A very special home and location! This warm and charming expanded 3 bedroom - 2 bath split level on .57 acre has been updated and designed for large families, indoor/outdoor entertaining, and/or working from home. Incredible flexibility including a possible In-law apartment conversion located on the main floor. With a blend of classic design and open floor plan this home is an ideal haven for creating lasting memories and enjoying family. The Main floor includes the oversized dining room, living room, full bath, and family room with a central fireplace creating a welcoming atmosphere. From the dining room is an expanded/updated country kitchen with light oak custom cabinetry and travertine tile backsplash. A few steps away is the enclosed porch and large deck overlooking a beautiful, private backyard for family gatherings. Just off the kitchen is the lower family room and office with laundry and attached garage. The upper floor creates privacy with full bath and 3 bedrooms including the primary bedroom all with hardwood floors. Additional features attached garage. Minutes to East Norwalk Train/Metro North, I-95, Merritt Parkway, shopping/dining and seconds from track/field at All Saints School and West Rocks Middle School.
